epaper:
A different kind of screen

More like a photograph.
Less like another screen.

Color e-paper reflects the light around it, much like paper. Once a photo is displayed, the panel can hold that still image without continuous power to maintain it.

Made to stay
The picture remains between updates.
A softer kind of color
A matte, reflective surface instead of a glowing display.
A place in your day
Set it beside your books, your coffee, or your bedside lamp.

Taking photos and changing the image still use battery power. Final battery life and display performance will be confirmed before launch.

faq:
A few good questions

Curious?
Start here.

An early look at what we're making.
Here's what we can share today.

What is keeper.day?+

A palm-sized camera with a color e-paper display, currently in development. The idea is simple: take a photo and give it a visible place in your everyday life.

Does it print photos?+

The photo appears on the color e-paper display. It isn't a paper print: it's a changeable, reflective image that stays on the device.

Does the photo stay when the screen isn't powered?+

E-paper can retain a static image without continuous power to hold that image. Taking photos, operating the camera, and refreshing the screen still require power. This does not mean unlimited battery life; final performance will be confirmed with hardware testing.

How does the pre-order work?+

Pre-order one camera for US$199 plus US$20 US shipping: US$219 paid in full today. Each order includes one camera. Shipping is expected to begin in August 2027. Your Stripe confirmation and receipt document your order. See the order details.

Where and when will you ship?+

Our first release ships to United States addresses only. We expect to begin shipping in August 2027; this is an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery date. If the schedule changes, we will email you with the updated estimate and your option to continue or cancel for a full refund before shipment.

Can I cancel or return my order?+

Before shipment, you can cancel for a full refund of the camera and shipping. Within 14 days after delivery, you can request a return if the camera is unused and in its original packaging. You pay return shipping for non-quality returns; we pay it for quality issues. Refunds go to the original payment method. Contact support@keeper.day with your order email and receipt reference. Full terms.

Are the app and widgets available?+

The app screens are design explorations. We're considering ways to personalize the device, including settings, photo looks, and small widgets. The final feature set has not been confirmed.

Are these final product photos?+

The product images are design references. Lifestyle scenes are AI-created illustrations, not customer photos or testimonials. Details such as dimensions, accessories, and the wrist strap remain subject to final engineering.
